f3_program: collection("owen.turtles", "turtle", "owen", source("Owen bred 21 turtles"))
collection("johanna.turtles", "turtle", "johanna", source("Johanna has 5 fewer turtles than Owen"))
produce("owen_breeds_turtles", "owen", at("owen.turtles.count", "current"), 21, source("Owen bred 21 turtles"))
offset(at("johanna.turtles.count", "before"), at("owen.turtles.count", "before"), -5, "count", source("Johanna has 5 fewer turtles than Owen"))
multiple(at("owen.turtles.count", "after_1_month"), at("owen.turtles.count", "before"), 2, source("After 1 month, Owen has twice as many turtles as before"))
remove("johanna_loses_turtles", "johanna", at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), fraction(at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("Johanna loses half of her turtles"))
transfer("johanna_donates_turtles", "johanna", at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), at("owen.turtles.count", "current"), at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), source("donates the rest to Owen"))
query("value", at("owen.turtles.count", "current"))
collection("james.cattle", "cattle", "james", source("Jame's buys 100 head of cattle"))
add("james_buys_cattle", "james", at("james.cattle.count", "current"), 100, source("Jame's buys 100 head of cattle"))
observe(at("james.cattle.purchase_cost.total", "purchase"), 40000, "dollar", source("Jame's buys 100 head of cattle for $40,000"))

collection("louise.gathering.cakes", "cake", "gathering", source("Louise is baking cakes for a gathering"))
observe(at("louise.gathering.cakes.required.count", "current"), 60, "count", source("She needs 60 cakes in total"))

produce("louise_already_produced_cakes", "louise", at("louise.gathering.cakes.produced.count", "current"), fraction(at("louise.gathering.cakes.required.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("has already produced half this many"))

difference_relation(at("louise.gathering.cakes.left_to_make.count", "today"), at("louise.gathering.cakes.required.count", "current"), at("louise.gathering.cakes.produced.count", "current"), source("Today, she calculates how many cakes she has left to make"))

produce("louise_bakes_today", "louise", at("louise.gathering.cakes.produced.count", "current"), fraction(at("louise.gathering.cakes.left_to_make.count", "today"), 1, 2), source("bakes half this amount"))

difference_relation(at("louise.gathering.cakes.left_to_make.count", "next_day"), at("louise.gathering.cakes.required.count", "current"), at("louise.gathering.cakes.produced.count", "current"), source("The next day, she again calculates how many cakes she has left to make"))

produce("louise_bakes_next_day", "louise", at("louise.gathering.cakes.produced.count", "current"), fraction(at("louise.gathering.cakes.left_to_make.count", "next_day"), 1, 3), source("bakes a third of this amount"))
query("difference", at("louise.gathering.cakes.produced.count", "current"), at("louise.gathering.cakes.required.count", "current"))
